title: Keto Veal Tagine
description: A flavorful and nutritious keto recipe inspired by traditional Algerian cuisine, slow-cooked to tender perfection in a rich tagine sauce.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the veal cubes in batches until browned, about 5 minutes per batch. Remove from pot and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and add the minced garlic. Cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the tagine spice blend and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chicken broth, browned veal, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer to the oven.
Braise the tagine for 2 hours, or until the veal is tender and falls apart easily.
Garnish with chopped parsley and cilantro. Serve hot.
